item.title: China taps Pacific metals trove in first large-scale seabed ore mining trial
item.description: China has carried out its first large-scale trial of seabed ore mining in international waters, using a robotic vehicle to gather potato-sized, metal-rich rocks from the eastern Pacific between Hawaii and Mexico, according to state media. The rocks collected during the trial – known as polymetallic nodules – contain nickel, cobalt, manganese and copper, which are key ingredients in the batteries used for electric cars and smartphones. item.title: DESI weighs the Milky Way more precisely than ever
item.description: To estimate the Milky Way's mass, astronomers need to track the movements of stars and smaller satellite galaxies under its gravitational pull. The faster these objects travel at a given distance, the more mass is needed to hold them in place. For some time, these measurements have shown that most of our galaxy's mass can't be accounted for by the stars and gas we can see. However, they have also produced estimates that differ widely. Fuente: Phys.org.
